assets.name: Sage_AI System Context
assets.notes: Fifth release. The system instructions as in the library on 11/16/2026. Both plugins are tested. The plugins cannot trigger the refresh of a linked table, so Sage_AI lists the documents that embed it and asks the Product Owner to refresh each one. No script applies edits to a Document. The Sage_AI Doc Edits skill and the Sage_AI Edits script are retired and removed from the repository. The 20261114 and 20261112 files stay as history. Sixth release, the same day, so it replaces the 20261116 file. The mission rules carry the brief outline, the live doc practice, and the brief for the next mission as a standard closing deliverable. Deliver Changes to Documents gains two rules for linked tables. Sage_AI Skill and Sage_AI Context point to the Lexicon. No skill is published.

assets.name: Sage_AI Product Owner LinkedIn Content
assets.notes: First release. Turns a transcript, a captured interview, or a Sage_AI interview into fifteen LinkedIn posts, each with three hooks, image text, share text, and an HTML image card, as one validated ProductSage import file. Reads the Product Owner's content profile for envelope values, brand slots, and style overrides. Carries templates A to O, the style rules, the import format at schema version 1.0, the interview questions, and a validator with a self test.
